meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行指令编排视频内容,自动完成渲染与发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望用脚本化方式制作和渲染视频,不想依赖图形界面。
copy.tagline_en: Create and render videos via command line, from keyframes to cloud targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer scripted video work over manual editing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会调用 HyperFrames 命令完成视频合成的初始化、查找并添加动作、编写合成、lint/check 检查、预览、渲染与发布；也覆盖本地、HeyGen 云、AWS Lambda 与 Google Cloud Run 渲染，并在构建或渲染失败时诊断问题。
howto.when: 当用户处于 HyperFrames 开发循环中的某个步骤（如初始化、预览渲染、发布等），或要求诊断构建/渲染失败时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperframes 初始化一个项目并加入逐行显示标题的动作。
say.note: 会先查目录、安装动作，再生成项目骨架。

say.text: 先跑 lint 再跑 check，然后打开后台预览。
say.note: check 会重跑 lint 并审计浏览器中的错误。

say.text: 用 draft 质量渲染成 out.mp4，确认文件已生成。
say.note: 渲染后会验证文件存在及时长合理。

howto.what_en: It invokes the HyperFrames CLI loop (scaffold, catalog, add, author, lint/check, preview, render, publish) and covers local, HeyGen cloud, AWS Lambda, and Cloud Run rendering; also used to diagnose build/render failures.
howto.when_en: When the user is at a HyperFrames development step such as scaffolding, previewing, rendering, or publishing, or asks to diagnose a build/render failure.

say_en.text: Init a hyperframes project and add a reveal-headline move.
say_en.note: It searches the catalog, installs, and scaffolds the project.

say_en.text: Run lint and then check, then open the background preview.
say_en.note: check reruns lint and audits the browser render.

say_en.text: Render to out.mp4 at draft quality and confirm it exists.
say_en.note: Verifies the output and its duration afterwards.
